description: The menu of a shop from find_shops: categories and products with prices in DKK (incl. VAT) and whether they are available. A product with a unit is priced per unit (pcs, portion, pack, kg, g, l, cl, ml, m = metre). Also weight in grams, preparation time in minutes (orders for it need at least that much notice) and the main image when set. Optional query to only get matching products.

shop.description: The "shop" value from find_shops (not needed on a shop's own address <shop>.lenius.app/mcp)

name: get_menu
title: Get menu
